method: Read with WebFetch only on 2026-10-03 (the session's web search budget was spent, so pages were reached by their own navigation and by ESPN's public search endpoint). Family A is the club's own squad page or the league's own page. Family B is an independent publisher on another host, mostly ESPN's squad and player pages for season 2026-27. A row leaves pending only when an A and a B source agree on the day read. Namesakes are told apart by the birth date or age the sources print against the baked age in src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts (a 2025 row, so one year younger). Same row shapes as the ledger: confirmedStill rows carry club, movedTo rows carry from, to and realClub, removedClubNotModelled rows carry from and realClub, notCurrent rows carry from and why, pending rows carry club, checkedOn and the reason.
